title_as_printed: Values of the critical pressure, temperature and volume for hydrogen-water mixtures: critical data for pure water are from VDI-Wasserdampftafeln [33]
pressure_note: critical pressure of the mixture, bar (text: 'pressure in bar'); absolute/gauge not stated; transducers calibrated with dead-weight gauge, uncertainty 1 bar

value.what: critical pressure of H2-H2O mixture of given composition (property: critical locus, not solubility)

x_gas.what: overall H2 composition of the isopleth (independent variable)

composition.other_species: overall composition x_H2 in mol-% (column 'x_H2 mol-%') of the H2-H2O mixture; no salt

row_from_literature.reason: pure water critical data taken from VDI-Wasserdampftafeln, not measured here

extra_unmapped: T_c uncertainty +-0.5 C given in the header for all rows
conversion_needs: x_H2 mol-% to mole fraction (divide by 100)
notes: Printed '+-' entries split into value and uncertainty columns (p_c and V_c). Row 13 (40 mol-%) is extrapolated per footnote and V_c is a printed dash (not measured, empty cell). Row 0 pure water from literature. T_c column has no stated uncertainty per row other than header +-0.5 C. Only Table 1 of the paper holds numeric data; the pVT/excess-volume results are in figures. 1981 IPTS 1968 stated for the thermometer.
quality_remarks: audit 2026-10-02: CSV data row 12 (40 mol-% H2) is marked * (extrapolated by the authors) and is not measured: text p.4 'By extrapolation, T_c and p_c for the 40 mol-% H2 isopleth are estimated to be 383.3 C and 3000 bar'. The paper does not state saturation or absolute/gauge for the pressures (only 'The uncertainty in pressure measurements over the entire range was 1 bar'), so P.basis is unspecified.
